qa.answer: GWM ORA 5 is our Stylish Premium SUV — a refined, urban-friendly electric crossover designed for European drivers who want presence and comfort. It is **coming soon** to Europe. You can preview it on the official model page.
GWM H7 is *Driven By Bold Intelligence* — a flagship intelligent SUV combining advanced driver-assistance with a confident design. **Coming soon** to Europe.
GWM JOLION MAX is our versatile, stylish and fun urban SUV — built for everyday city life with bold styling. **Coming soon** to Europe.

GWM is bringing **3 new models** to Europe:
• **ORA 5** — Stylish Premium SUV
• **H7** — Driven By Bold Intelligence
• **JOLION MAX** — Versatile Urban SUV

All three are *Coming Soon*. Want details on any of them?

GWM is actively expanding its European dealer network. The **Cooperation** section covers dealership opportunities, fleet sales and careers. Send a partnership enquiry to **info@gwm-eu.com** with your company profile and target market.
GWM offers a comprehensive **warranty and service** programme across Europe, including genuine spare parts and certified service centres. See the warranty page for full terms.
GWM invests heavily in R&D, with global tech centres covering electrification, intelligent driving and connected services. The **Technology** page details our platforms and innovation roadmap.
You can reach GWM Europe at **info@gwm-eu.com**, or follow us on Instagram and Facebook. For region-specific enquiries, visit the contact page.

Pricing for the upcoming European models hasn't been published yet — they're still labelled *Coming Soon*. Sign up via the official model pages or email **info@gwm-eu.com** to be notified when local pricing and orders open.
GWM Europe runs three localised sites: **EU (English)**, **Spain (Spanish)** and **Italy (Italian)**. You can switch in the top-right of the page header.

**Great Wall Motor (GWM)** is a global automotive manufacturer serving **16+ million users worldwide**. Our European arm is rolling out a new generation of SUVs under the brand promise *Go With More*.
Latest GWM Europe news — including the **All-new compact ORA 5 family kickstart** and the **GWM Europe Partner Day** — is published in the news section.
